name: jidr
description: See and drive Android emulators on your Mac: screenshot, tap, type, read the UI and logs, and run any Jidr command.
long_description: Jidr is a free, open-source Android emulator manager for Apple Silicon Macs with one-click rooted devices. This extension runs `jidr mcp`, which starts the Jidr daemon when needed. Agents can create, start and stop devices, install apps, take screenshots, tap, swipe, type, read the uiautomator tree and tail logcat. Destructive commands (delete, factory reset) are refused unless the device is agent-owned (D5). Jidr downloads Google's Android SDK and system images on your Mac the first time, after you accept their licence in the Jidr app or CLI.
